verdict.rationale: A single /convert endpoint takes 'a PDF, image, or document' and returns Markdown, HTML, JSON, or chunks, and the docs name Word documents and spreadsheets. The underlying Marker engine lists PDF, image, PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, HTML, and EPUB, so most of the story's mix goes through one call without per-format plumbing. missing for 10: email (EML/MSG) support, explicit hosted-API docs confirming PPTX and HTML input, independent hands-on corroboration of non-PDF formats.
